Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
This is an Android role on Reddit’s Design System Team. The mission of the Design System Team is to deliver a cohesive, modern and accessible experience across all of Reddit’s platforms.
As a Senior Android engineer on the Design System Team, you will help evolve Reddit’s cross-platform design system and UI architecture that powers experiences across the company. You will build reusable components, improve platform capabilities, and help establish frontend patterns that enable product teams to ship high-quality experiences efficiently. This role has broad scope and impact, helping shape the future of frontend development at Reddit.

Evolve Reddit’s cross-platform design system by expanding its capabilities and developing higher-level reusable components that accelerate product development while maintaining consistency and quality.
Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, designers, and engineers to ensure the design system and UI infrastructure effectively support real product needs.
Improve performance at scale , contributing to Android architecture, rendering patterns, and performance-focused development practices that make performance a built-in feature of the platform.
Advance accessibility across the platform , building accessible components, patterns, tooling, and documentation that help teams adopt accessibility best practices by default.
Strengthen developer experience , contributing to shared tooling, documentation, and platform improvements that help engineers build reliable, consistent UI across Reddit’s products.

6+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of leading cross-functional projects and delivering solutions with broad product impact.
Experience building and maintaining shared UI infrastructure, such as design systems, component libraries, or frontend infrastructure used across multiple teams.
Strong experience with modern Android development using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, with expertise in UI architecture, scalable component design, and performance optimization using tools such as Instruments.
Familiarity with accessibility best practices and an interest in building components, tooling, or documentation that help teams ship accessible experiences by default.
You embody Reddit’s core value of “Evolve” — you embrace ambiguity, seek feedback, and continuously improve your craft and the platform you help build.

About Niche Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them.

We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply. Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

About The Role Every year, millions of families start the school search process.

Students wade through a sea of information and decisions to make, and unfortunately access to help hasn’t changed much in decades: it’s not super clear what your options are, and you might not feel confident that a school is right for you, or think you’ll be able to afford it.

Niche is on a mission to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. Students need support choosing a school and paying for their education, schools want to find students who will thrive on their campus, and families need help supporting their students every step of the way.

Niche helps ensure that it’s not just students already confident about college who get enrolled and can afford to attend.

We’re looking for a Staff Design Systems Engineer to help define what modern design-to-code looks like at Niche , starting with overhauling our design system Expedite in partnership with two dedicated Product Engineers and the rest of the Product Design team.

This is an exciting UX engineering role that requires both frontend and design fluency and reports to the Senior Director of Product Design. You’ll build and ship accessible, production-ready components, create and use AI tooling and LLM guidelines, and help shape new design workflows.

You will work closely with designers and engineers to help shape the foundations, components, and patterns that product teams will rely on every day. Starting on day one, you will build your understanding of real product needs and then translate them into scalable systems, tools and processes, ensuring that they grow alongside the company.

Your work will help unlock speed and quality across the Product org. This role is ideal for a builder who is eager for more ownership.

The biggest opportunities: scope of ownership and freedom to experiment, design the future of product design and development at Niche , and overhaul our design systems with your vision, agentic automation, and a lot of love.

You will sit at the intersection of craft, systems thinking, collaboration, and design excellence, with senior leadership support and guidance on delivering your dreams to production. The Design team is so excited for this role to be open and can’t wait to work with you!

What You Will Do Design, refine and ship reusable and accessible components, tokens, and interaction patterns that enable teams to build consistent, high-quality experiences across web and mobile Contribute code to production and support Product Designers contributing code to production using agentic coding tools (Claude Code, custom internal tools) Establish LLM guidelines that align with the Why Harvey
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished.

We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Harvey designs and builds for a legal industry being reshaped by AI, moving with the urgency and ambition the moment demands, not just adapting to change but architecting it. As a Design Systems Designer at Harvey, you will define the foundations that make our product coherent, scalable, and trustworthy as it grows in complexity.

The design system is not just a library of components. It is the shared language between design, engineering, and AI that ensures consistency, quality, and confidence across every interaction.
This is a design role with unusual technical depth. You lead with design: craft, systems thinking, and a strong point of view on product experience. But you're equally at home in architecture and implementation. You understand how tokens are structured, how components are composed, and how systems are built to scale, and you use that fluency to push the system forward rather than hand decisions over the wall.
We're looking for someone who has lived through the evolution of the discipline, someone who understands not just how modern design systems work, but why they're built the way they are, and where the field is heading, especially as AI-native products reshape what a design system needs to be.
This role will report to the Design org, and will be based in SF, NYC, or Toronto.

Build an AI-native design system that sets the bar for design quality for Design, Engineering, and Product through technical direction and collaboration
Design, prototype, and ship production-ready system components in tight collaboration with frontend and platform engineering, with shared ownership of quality, performance, and maintainability
Define and evolve the core design system foundations (components, patterns, and tokens) that scale across complex, AI-powered experiences
Push both the architecture and the implementation of the system: shape component APIs, token structure, theming, and composition patterns alongside engineering, not downstream of it
Advocate for technical approaches with confidence, especially in new or ambiguous territory where established patterns don't yet exist
Embed accessibility, responsiveness, and performance into the system by default
Establish clear contribution, governance, and deprecation models that balance velocity with system integrity
Raise the bar for system quality across the product through design reviews, critique, and hands-on work
Build alignment across Design, Engineering, and Product through technical direction and collaboration
Anticipate future product and platform needs, evolving the system proactively as Harvey scales
Own AI design and implementation workflows for the design team, establishing best practices for prototyping and shipping with AI
Establish in-code prototyping patterns that make it easier to be innovative and consistent as designers increasingly leverage IDEs to experiment and ship.
Define AI-assisted design and implementation workflows, establishing best practices for prototyping and shipping with AI
Document system usage and best practices in a way that is clear, practical, and trusted by product teams
What you have
5+ years (Senior) / 8+ years (Staff) of product design experience, with significant ownership of design systems in complex product environments
A design portfolio that demonstrates high design craft in system-level thinking, but a strong point of view on quality, and visual cohesion
Deep design systems expertise, including an understanding of the history and evolution of the discipline. You know why the field moved from style guides to tokens to composable architectures, and you have a point of view on what comes next
Excellent design engineering communication: you articulate system decisions and tradeoffs fluently to designers, engineers, and cross-functional partners
Ability to clearly articulate system decisions and tradeoffs to designers, engineers, and cross-functional partners
Strong knowledge of scalable system architecture and component implementation: component API design, design tokens, theming strategies, and how systems hold up across teams and codebases
Design Engineer experience preferred, but not required in an AI-first world where the boundary between design and engineering is shifting
High ownership: you treat the system as a product, not a ticket queue
Strong opinions, loosely held, being comfortable challenging conventions and evolving best practices as the discipline changes
Comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces and bringing structure where it doesn't yet exist
Why design systems matter at Harvey
Harvey is an AI-native product. As the system reasons, responds, and adapts in real time, the interface must remain consistent and legible. A strong design system ensures that complexity does not leak into the experience. It enables teams to move faster, reduces cognitive load for users, and builds trust in moments where clarity matters most.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity.

World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes.

We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
Why this role matters
At Celonis, design has to scale across a complex, enterprise-grade process intelligence platform, and increasingly, it has to scale to machines as well as people. AI coding agents now generate a growing share of the UI our engineers ship, and our design system is the contract that keeps that output on-brand, accessible, and consistent.
This role sits at the intersection of design, engineering, and product, with a strong emphasis on craft, usability, and scalability. You'll design and build the system itself, owning interaction decisions and front-end architecture, and translating complex process data and AI-driven behaviors into intuitive, high-performance experiences.

It's a senior role: you'll often operate with minimal design oversight, set standards, lead initiatives, and mentor others while staying deeply hands-on in both design and code.

You'll join the team that owns Celonis's design system and the operations behind how design gets done. We sit at the intersection of design and engineering, and we treat the system as a living product with real users, internal designers, product engineers, and the AI agents that now consume it.

Design and build production components in Angular and TypeScript, our design system is built in Angular and we may adopt React over time, on a foundation of rock-solid HTML and CSS (semantic markup, ARIA, and modern CSS custom properties driving design tokens).
Own interaction decisions, component design, and front-end architecture end-to-end, independently translating ambiguous requirements into thoughtful, usable UX.
Translate complex process-intelligence data and AI-driven behaviors into clear, intuitive, high-performance operator experiences.
Set the technical and craft standard for front-end quality, polish, motion and animation, performance, and accessibility, across the team.
Drive rapid prototyping to explore novel interaction concepts and turn ambitious design visions into distinctive, testable experiences.
Collaborate with designers, PMs, and engineers to derive and evolve the design system through a healthy contribution model.
Make the system agent-ready: maintain tokens-as-code in the W3C DTCG format (Style Dictionary or similar) and structure component metadata, docs, and APIs so AI coding agents can consume them as reliable context.
Author and maintain Figma Code Connect mappings so Figma components link cleanly to their coded counterparts for engineers and agents alike.
Build evals as guardrails, visual-regression, accessibility, and token-compliance checks in CI, so generated and contributed UI meets the bar before it ships.
Use AI tooling daily (Figma Make, v0, Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar), applying senior design and engineering judgment to critique and correct the output.
Lead system initiatives and mentor designers and engineers contributing to it.

Around 5–8 years across design engineering / UX engineering / front-end, including significant hands-on work building a design system or component library in a SaaS or B2B environment.
Excellent UX instincts with strong attention to interaction detail and usability, you can own design decisions independently, with minimal oversight.
Strong production front-end skills in Angular and TypeScript with rock-solid HTML and CSS fundamentals; experience with (or genuine openness to) React is a plus.
Deep understanding of design token architecture (primitive → semantic → component tiers) and modern token pipelines.
Strong Figma fluency and comfort moving fluidly between design and code.
Demonstrated accessibility expertise (WCAG 2.2) implemented in code.
Hands-on fluency with AI design and coding tools, and an opinionated, responsible point of view on using them.
A strong product mindset and bias toward ownership, plus the communication and leadership of a senior IC.

Experience with Figma Code Connect in production.
Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers e.g. the Figma Dev Mode MCP server or a custom design-system MCP server.
Experience building evals for AI-generated UI, or writing specs/prompts for AI generation.
Background working on complex, data-dense, or real-time interfaces (a strong fit for our process-intelligence product).
Token-pipeline experience with Style Dictionary, Tokens Studio, or equivalent.
How we work
This is a senior role: you'll own major areas of the system with full autonomy, design and ship with a high bar for craft, set the standards others build to, lead initiatives, and mentor. We pair design craft with engineering depth and high curiosity about AI, building a system that's faster and safer for humans and agents alike.

Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

We are looking for a Head of Design Systems to join the Brand and Design team at Doctolib.
Your mission will be to ensure every Doctolib product surface is built on a consistent, high-quality design foundation. You will own Oxygen , Doctolib's design system - much more than a component library.

Oxygen is how we deliver our brand identity consistently throughout the product and the critical infrastructure that ensures design quality at scale across an AI-first development environment.

With over 50 designers and engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work will directly shape the experience of more than 90 million patients and 400,000 healthcare professionals.
Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

s.h: Your responsibilities include but are not limited to
s.t:
Set the multi-year vision and roadmap for Oxygen, connecting the dots across engineering, design, and brand teams. Translate system health into business impact and own the investment strategy for the teams, tools, and governance that support it.
Establish cross-functional governance across Design, Product, Engineering, and Brand teams, defining contribution models, change management processes, and the standards other teams are expected to follow.
Own design output quality across the product, ensuring that AI-generated interfaces are coherent, consistent, and on-brand at every touchpoint across the company.
Define and drive cross-organizational adoption, measuring adoption rate, component coverage, and contribution velocity, and connecting those metrics to product team speed and quality.
Manage and grow a team of design system designers and engineers, setting career paths, a high bar for craft, and hiring for the roles the system needs next.
Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

s.h: You'll be a great fit if you
s.t:
Have 10+ years of experience in product design or design systems, with a proven track record of scaling a mature, complex system across multiple product teams or lines of business
Bring engineering fluency: you understand the technical architecture of a design system, how platform teams operate, and the latest best practices in AI-first software engineering as it relates to design systems
Have demonstrated senior stakeholder management skills, with the ability to negotiate priorities with leadership at Director level and above across large, distributed organizations, and drive change management at scale
Take a data-informed and outcome-oriented approach: you measure system health in real metrics (adoption rate, handoff defect rate, contribution velocity) and connect those numbers to product quality and business outcomes
Have experience in a regulated, enterprise, or healthcare-adjacent context where accessibility (WCAG), localization (i18n, RTL), and multi-market constraints are critical to design systems
Are fluent in English

s.h: It would be fantastic if you
s.t:
Have experience owning large-scale change management programs across cross-functional organizations
Speak additional European languages, such as French, German, or Italian

s.h: About the team and the role
s.t:
An eBay subsidiary, TCGplayer is on a quest to be the most trusted trading card game (TCG) platform — connecting and empowering the hobby community. Trading card games are a $25B global market that creates community connection through in-person games (Pokemon; Magic: The Gathering; YuGiOh; etc.). Founded by TCG enthusiasts, we operate a global marketplace, and create tools, technologies and solutions that help small businesses profitably sell TCGs at scale.
As a Principal Product Designer, Design Systems, you will shape the future of TCGplayer's product experience by evolving the shared design system that powers our end-to-end commerce ecosystem—from marketplace experiences and seller tools to fulfillment and robotic inventory digitization systems.

You will establish and continuously elevate the visual language, interaction patterns, and experience standards that define our products, helping transform them into cohesive, intuitive, and professional-grade experiences that reflect the quality of an eBay company.

Working at the intersection of design, engineering, and technology, you will create the shared foundation that enables teams to deliver exceptional user experiences with greater speed, consistency, and quality while advancing AI-assisted design and development through modern design systems, design tokens, and code-connected workflows.
Our User Experience Design team prides itself on creating a culture that fosters camaraderie, embraces diversity, and exudes passion. We value curiosity, craft, and a desire to directly interact with the real world.

You don’t have to be a hobbyist or gamer to love working in TCGplayer’s UX Design organization, but you should be eager to amplify our steadfast commitment to making hobbies and games accessible, fun, and rewarding for everyone.

If you’re equal parts “empathy” and “ambition,” this is an opportunity to take risks and stretch yourself, surrounded by teammates who will support you along the way.

Own and evolve TCGplayer's design system across our commerce ecosystem, establishing the visual language, interaction patterns, and reusable components that power consistent, high-quality products.
Partner closely with Design and Engineering to ensure the design system is implemented consistently across both Figma and code, improving quality, maintainability, and development efficiency.
Define and maintain design standards, governance, documentation, and contribution models that enable the system to scale as the organization grows.
Advance our design tooling by developing and maintaining component libraries, design tokens, variables, and workflows that improve designer productivity and implementation fidelity.
Raise the quality bar across the organization by evolving our visual language, accessibility standards, and UX patterns based on a deep understanding of our customers’ unique needs.
Partner with UX Design and Product teams on strategic roadmap initiatives, design sprints, and vision work to define new interaction patterns and experience frameworks that solve emerging customer needs and evolve the design system through practical application in shipped products.
Champion modern design and development workflows, including AI-assisted design and design-to-code capabilities, ensuring our design system is prepared for the future of product development.

8+ years of experience in Product, UX, Visual, or Experience Design, including significant experience designing and evolving enterprise-scale design systems for complex digital products.
Demonstrated expertise in design systems architecture, including component libraries, design tokens, variables, interaction patterns, documentation, governance, and scalable contribution models.
Exceptional visual and interaction design skills with a portfolio that demonstrates the ability to create elegant, intuitive, and highly polished product experiences while translating them into reusable system assets.
Familiarity with emerging AI-assisted design and design-to-code workflows, and a strong interest in shaping how design systems enable the future of product development.
Experience designing for desktop, responsive web, and native mobile experiences, with the ability to create scalable patterns that work cohesively across platforms.
Deep understanding of how design systems are implemented in code, with experience partnering closely with Engineering to ensure consistency between design and production through shared components, tokens, and front-end technologies.
Ability to define and evolve design languages, interaction models, and UX standards that improve product quality, consistency, accessibility, and efficiency across multiple products and teams.
Experience establishing new interaction patterns and translating innovations from product work into scalable design system capabilities that can be adopted across an organization.
Strong systems thinking and the ability to balance immediate product needs with long-term platform health, maintainability, and scalability.
Experience with modern design tooling including Figma component libraries, variables, design tokens, and prototyping, with a passion for improving how designers and engineers work together.
Outstanding communication and facilitation skills, with a proven track record of building alignment across Design, Product, and Engineering.

Experience in eCommerce, marketplaces, seller tools, SaaS, fintech, or other complex product ecosystems
Demonstrated experience implementing AI-assisted design and development workflows, including integrating design systems with AI-powered prototyping, design generation, and design-to-code pipelines
Familiarity with the gaming, hobby, or collectibles community — particularly trading card games
Additional Details
The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:
$127,600 - $214,700 Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience.

The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave).

Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

Verity is hiring a founding Senior Manager, Design Systems Engineer to build Verity Canvas, our code-canonical design system for healthcare software.This role sits at the center of Figma, React,accessibility, andproduction code.

You will keep our real codebase and Figma library aligned, turning design decisions into type-safe, accessible components that product teams can trust. As we migrate from Angular to React, you will help build the system that makes our next generation of UI consistent, scalable, and meaningful for the people who rely on it.

Own the @verity/uicomponentlibrary as a versioned package built on accessible headless primitives and styled through design tokens.
Build andmaintainthe @verity/tokens pipeline from DTCG design tokens through Style Dictionary, CSS custom properties, and typed output.
Create a code-to-Figma token workflow using Figma Variables, staging files, and review practices that prevent silent designdrift.
Author Code Connectmappingsso Figma Dev Mode and coding agents generate real @verity/ui components instead of generic markup.
Define the AI-ready system surface, including MCP context,componentmanifests, registries, repo guidance, and agent evaluation workflows.
Strengthen CI quality gates for accessibility, visual regression, app-level regression, linting, and code ownership.
Manage release discipline through Changesets, semantic versioning, API contract checks, and migration-readycodemods.
Partner with designers and product teams on Figma conventions, adoption, governance, promotion, anddeprecationworkflows.

Minimum5+ years of experience building front-end systems, design systems, orcomponentlibraries with React and TypeScript.
Experience designing typedcomponentAPIs and shipping a design system as a published package used by other teams.
Hands-on experience with Figma Dev Mode, variables, and Code Connect, or similar design-to-code workflows.
Experience building design token pipelines using DTCG formats and tools such as Style Dictionary or Tokens Studio.
Strong accessibilityexpertise, including ARIA, keyboard interaction, focus management, and automated checks such as axe.
Experience with Storybook, visual regression testing, CI/CD, modern Git workflows, and package management inmonorepos.

Experience with Base UI, Radix, React Aria,Ariakit, or similar headless primitive libraries.
Experience withpnpmworkspaces,Turborepo, Changesets,semver, API Extractor, or type-awarecodemods.
Experience with AI-native development workflows, MCP tooling, coding agents, registries, or agent evaluation harnesses.
Experience pushing tokens from code into Figma or working with the Figma Variables REST API.
Experience in healthcare, regulated environments, or products where accessibility and precision are essential.

About Gusto
At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

We're looking for a AI-native Design Systems Designer to join Gusto's Builder Enablement team — the team responsible for Workbench, Gusto's internal design system, and for how every designer and engineer at Gusto ships high-quality work with AI assistance.
This role sits at an exciting and genuinely new intersection: deep design systems craft combined with fluency in AI-assisted workflows.

You'll help evolve and maintain Workbench at a pivotal moment — we're mid-Brand Refresh, actively building AI tooling to improve how builders interact with the system, and expanding how the design system serves LLMs and AI-assisted products as much as it serves human designers.

The ideal candidate is a rigorous systems thinker with strong component and token expertise who is excited about using AI tools as a core part of how they work, not just an add-on. We use Figma as a helper tool, but our deliverables are code. The level of this role is similar to/equivalent of a Senior Staff-level.

The Builder Enablement team's mission is to make high-quality, AI-assisted shipping the default for every builder at Gusto. We own Workbench, Gusto's design system, but we also own how it gets expressed to AI tools and builders. Our work spans component design and documentation, token architecture, AI tooling (including MCP servers, prompt engineering, and eval systems), and supporting the broader design and engineering org in using the system well.
We're a small, tight-knit team of designers and engineers embedded within Gusto's design organization, led by our CDO, Amy Thibodeau. We care deeply about craft, systems thinking, and making complex things feel simple for the people who depend on us.
Product Design at Gusto is made up of over 70 creative, collaborative people who care deeply about our mission to empower small businesses and their employees.

We’re a cross-functional bunch focused on Design, Research, Writing, Ops and Front-end Development who are always looking for opportunities to build understanding and empathy for the people who use Gusto.

We don’t care a whole lot about swim lanes and we work closely with our partners in Product, Engineering, Data, and Marketing to design, build and ship experiences that make a difference. We are passionate advocates for thoughtful, crafted, and inclusive experiences and we believe great design can make hard things possible, even delightful.

Design and maintain Workbench components and patterns, including complex components with variables, variants, and tokenized styles
Own and evolve semantic and functional token architecture as we execute the Brand Refresh and move toward theming
Work closely with our engineering team to ensure component consistency including coded implementations — pairing on design decisions, reviewing implementations, contributing to technical plans, and committing your own PRs.
Contribute to AI tooling that helps designers and engineers use Workbench correctly — including structured documentation, storybook examples, and content that makes the system legible to LLMs
Support product designers and engineers through Office Hours, Slack, and async review
Document and publish design decisions, usage guidance, and component rationale
Participate in systemic decisions about component architecture, naming conventions, and migration strategy — especially in the context of the ongoing Brand Refresh

Design Systems Experience: 4 + years working on a product design systems team through the full lifecycle — design, implementation, documentation, and adoption. Experience with token architecture and component API design is required.
Product Design Experience: 7+ years experience working on a product design team
AI Fluency: Genuine experience using AI tools (Claude, Copilot, or similar) as a meaningful part of your workflow — not just experimentally. Comfort directing AI assistance, evaluating its output, and knowing where human judgment is required.
Technical Acumen: Ability to pair effectively with engineering, understand technical plans and constraints, and contribute meaningfully to implementation decisions and code repos
Accessibility Minded: A solid understanding of WCAG AA guidelines and how accessibility considerations shape component and token decisions.
Technical Skill: Expert knowledge of AI design tools and Figma, including complex component construction, variable and token usage, prototyping, and basic Github process.
Design Integrity: High degree of design craft and polish, with a strong point of view about what good looks like in a design system.
Communication: Documentation expertise and the ability to educate and align peers across disciplines. Demonstrated ability to advocate for systemic consistency while remaining collaborative and service-minded.
Additional Experience: Experience with LLM-readable documentation, MCP servers, or AI-assisted design tooling.
Our cash compensation range for this role is $147,000/yr to $215,000/yr in Denver, and $178,000/yr to $253,000/yr in San Francisco and New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.
Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.
Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.
When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.
Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.
The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide.

Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem
Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful
Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type
Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming brand refresh
Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development
Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability
Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

s.h: You'll be a great fit for this role if you
s.t:
Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications
Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each
Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable
Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought
Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation
Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team
Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment
Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team

## Job Description ##
Reporting to the Design Manager, you will own and develop the design system across our website and digital media, ensuring consistent, accessible and scalable digital experiences.
Working closely with UX/UI designers, developers and other stakeholders, you will create and maintain components, templates and guidelines, translate needs into practical solutions, and ensure their correct implementation.
You will also drive the adoption and continuous improvement of the design system across teams. Excellent Figma skills and strong knowledge of design system methodologies are required; familiarity with HTML, CSS and component architecture is a plus.

* Manage and develop the design system in Figma using AI.
* Create and document components, styles, variables and their guidelines for use.
* Check consistency of interfaces across the entire website (.com).
* Help designers to successfully adopt the design system.
* Facilitate collaboration between the design, copywriting, integration and development teams.
* Work with developers to ensure accurate integration of components.
* Participate in building interfaces that are simple, accessible and adapted to all screen formats.
* Centralise, organise and prioritise requests for updates to the design system.
* Stay up to date in good UX/UI practices, accessibility rules and new design tools, particularly using artificial intelligence.

* Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role.
* Strong UX/UI and digital design expertise, with solid knowledge of interaction design, responsive design and accessibility standards.
* Proven experience designing digital interfaces and creating, managing and evolving design systems.
* Excellent command of Figma, in particular components, variants, variables, styles and shared libraries.
* Proven ability to coordinate, organise and develop a design system, making sure it is consistent, scalable and adopted by all teams.
* Proficiency in artificial intelligence tools and capacity to integrate generative AI into design processes, in order to optimise work methods, accelerate ideation and produce creative content.
* Experience collaborating with front-end developers and multi-disciplinary teams.
* Knowledge of HTML, CSS and component architecture a plus.
* Fluency in French and a good working knowledge of English.
